# Kitsunes
Graceful and mysterious fox people, often associated with old superstitions about flame and mischief.
## Diet
- Can eat raw meat. - Will get poisoned by Theobromine (Chocolate, Tea, Coffee) and Allicin (Onion, Garlic).
## Benefits
- Carries a kitsune-flavored speech style and accent. - Slightly more resistant to extreme temperatures than humans. - Capable in melee with a Felinid-style claw attack.
## Drawbacks
- More fragile than humans against blunt and slash damage. - Their small frame means struggling to carry or pull heavy things.
